verdict.rationale: Proa documents a very small client footprint: hydrated islands emit small vanilla-JS modules with a shared runtime of about 1.3 KB gzipped, and only islands that use signals and event handlers ship JavaScript. Some components ship no JS at all, such as CSS-only accordions and server-drawn SVG charts. UI components are vendored into the user's repo as owned source rather than pulled in as dependencies, which implies lower supply-chain exposure. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on measurement of bundle size, and explicit documentation of the client runtime's dependency footprint or supply-chain posture (this is only implied by the vanilla-JS and vendoring claims).
